#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""RoboPaint executor for the target in /app/target.png.

Uses centerlines from a deterministic thinning pass, rejoins short centerline
fragments to stay within the 42-contact limit, and varies tip pressure from the
target's local stroke width. Run with --pilot 39 to execute only the calibration
stroke; a normal run resumes all unrecorded strokes from progress.json.
"""
import argparse
import json
import pathlib
import sys
import time
from collections import defaultdict

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage as ndi
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

ROOT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
TARGET = pathlib.Path("/app/target.png")
STATE = ROOT / "progress.json"
MM_PER_PX = 227.185 / 1024.0
PAPER_FAR_X = 0.0135925
PAPER_LEFT_Y = 0.1135925
PAPER_Z = 0.0202
HOVER_Z = 0.075
PARK = (-0.10, 0.28, 0.35)
DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=np.float64)


def thin(mask):
    p = np.pad(mask.astype(bool), 1)
    while True:
        changed = False
        p2, p3, p4 = p[:-2, 1:-1], p[:-2, 2:], p[1:-1, 2:]
        p5, p6, p7 = p[2:, 2:], p[2:, 1:-1], p[2:, :-2]
        p8, p9 = p[1:-1, :-2], p[:-2, :-2]
        ring = [p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9]
        count = sum(x.astype(np.uint8) for x in ring)
        transitions = sum(((~ring[k]) & ring[(k + 1) % 8]).astype(np.uint8) for k in range(8))
        center = p[1:-1, 1:-1]
        for phase in (0, 1):
            remove = center & (count >= 2) & (count <= 6) & (transitions == 1)
            if phase == 0:
                remove &= (~(p2 & p4 & p6)) & (~(p4 & p6 & p8))
            else:
                remove &= (~(p2 & p4 & p8)) & (~(p2 & p6 & p8))
            if remove.any():
                center[remove] = False
                changed = True
        if not changed:
            break
    return p[1:-1, 1:-1]


def centerline_paths(mask):
    sk = thin(mask)
    pts = sorted(zip(*np.where(sk)))
    point_set = set(pts)
    adj = {p: [] for p in pts}
    for r, c in pts:
        for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
            for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
                if dr == dc == 0:
                    continue
                q = (r + dr, c + dc)
                if q not in point_set:
                    continue
                if dr and dc and ((r + dr, c) in point_set or (r, c + dc) in point_set):
                    continue
                adj[(r, c)].append(q)
        adj[(r, c)].sort()
    nodes = sorted(p for p in pts if len(adj[p]) != 2)

    def edgekey(a, b):
        return (a, b) if a < b else (b, a)

    used_edges = set()
    chains = []
    ports = defaultdict(list)
    for node in nodes:
        for nb in adj[node]:
            if edgekey(node, nb) in used_edges:
                continue
            arr = [node, nb]
            used_edges.add(edgekey(node, nb))
            prev, cur = node, nb
            while cur not in nodes:
                nxt = [p for p in adj[cur] if p != prev]
                if not nxt:
                    break
                q = nxt[0]
                if edgekey(cur, q) in used_edges:
                    break
                arr.append(q)
                used_edges.add(edgekey(cur, q))
                prev, cur = cur, q
            cid = len(chains)
            chains.append(arr)
            ports[arr[0]].append(cid)
            ports[arr[-1]].append(cid)
    # Any closed component without a branch node.
    for point in pts:
        avail = [q for q in adj[point] if edgekey(point, q) not in used_edges]
        if not avail:
            continue
        nb = avail[0]
        arr = [point, nb]
        used_edges.add(edgekey(point, nb))
        prev, cur = point, nb
        while cur != point:
            opts = [q for q in adj[cur] if q != prev and edgekey(cur, q) not in used_edges]
            if not opts:
                break
            q = opts[0]
            arr.append(q)
            used_edges.add(edgekey(cur, q))
            prev, cur = cur, q
        cid = len(chains)
        chains.append(arr)
        ports[point].extend((cid, cid))

    def outward(cid, node):
        arr = chains[cid]
        seq = arr[:min(7, len(arr))] if arr[0] == node else arr[-min(7, len(arr)):][::-1]
        v = np.asarray(seq[-1], float) - np.asarray(seq[0], float)
        return v / max(np.linalg.norm(v), 1e-8)

    def best_matching(ids, node):
        ids = list(ids)
        memo = {}
        def solve(rem):
            rem = tuple(rem)
            if rem in memo:
                return memo[rem]
            if len(rem) <= 1:
                return (0.0, [])
            i = rem[0]
            best = (float("inf"), [])
            # Pair i to one of the remaining ports.
            for j in rem[1:]:
                rest = tuple(x for x in rem if x not in (i, j))
                cost, pairs = solve(rest)
                score = cost + 1.0 + float(outward(i, node) @ outward(j, node))
                if score < best[0]:
                    best = (score, pairs + [(i, j)])
            # Odd-degree branches leave one port unmatched.
            if len(rem) % 2:
                cost, pairs = solve(rem[1:])
                if cost < best[0]:
                    best = (cost, pairs)
            memo[rem] = best
            return best
        return solve(ids)[1]

    paired = {}
    for node in nodes:
        ids = sorted(ports[node])
        if len(ids) >= 3:
            for a, b in best_matching(ids, node):
                paired[(node, a)] = b
                paired[(node, b)] = a

    terminals = []
    for node, ids in ports.items():
        if len(adj[node]) == 1:
            terminals.extend((node, cid) for cid in ids)
        else:
            terminals.extend((node, cid) for cid in ids if (node, cid) not in paired)
    paths = []
    used_chains = set()
    for start, cid0 in terminals:
        if cid0 in used_chains:
            continue
        arr = chains[cid0] if chains[cid0][0] == start else chains[cid0][::-1]
        path = list(arr)
        used_chains.add(cid0)
        node, cid = arr[-1], cid0
        while (node, cid) in paired:
            nxtid = paired[(node, cid)]
            if nxtid in used_chains:
                break
            nxt = chains[nxtid] if chains[nxtid][0] == node else chains[nxtid][::-1]
            path.extend(nxt[1:])
            used_chains.add(nxtid)
            node, cid = nxt[-1], nxtid
        paths.append(np.asarray(path, dtype=np.float32))
    for cid0, arr0 in enumerate(chains):
        if cid0 in used_chains:
            continue
        path = list(arr0)
        used_chains.add(cid0)
        node, cid = arr0[-1], cid0
        while (node, cid) in paired:
            nxtid = paired[(node, cid)]
            if nxtid in used_chains:
                break
            nxt = chains[nxtid] if chains[nxtid][0] == node else chains[nxtid][::-1]
            path.extend(nxt[1:])
            used_chains.add(nxtid)
            node, cid = nxt[-1], nxtid
        paths.append(np.asarray(path, dtype=np.float32))
    return paths


def join_fragments(paths, max_strokes=42):
    ends = [(i, s, p[0 if s == 0 else -1].astype(float))
            for i, p in enumerate(paths) for s in (0, 1)]
    candidates = []
    for ai, (i, si, a) in enumerate(ends):
        for j, sj, b in ends[ai + 1:]:
            if i != j:
                candidates.append((float(np.linalg.norm(a - b)), i, si, j, sj))
    candidates.sort()
    used = set()
    pairs = []
    for d, i, si, j, sj in candidates:
        if i in used or j in used:
            continue
        used.update((i, j))
        pairs.append((d, i, si, j, sj))
        if len(pairs) == len(paths) - max_strokes:
            break
    merged = []
    paired_ids = set()
    for d, i, si, j, sj in pairs:
        a, b = paths[i].copy(), paths[j].copy()
        if si == 0:
            a = a[::-1]
        if sj == 1:
            b = b[::-1]
        bridge_n = max(2, int(np.ceil(d)) + 1)
        bridge = np.linspace(a[-1], b[0], bridge_n, dtype=np.float32)[1:-1]
        merged.append(np.vstack((a, bridge, b)))
        paired_ids.update((i, j))
    for i, path in enumerate(paths):
        if i not in paired_ids:
            merged.append(path)
    return merged


def make_plan():
    rgb = np.asarray(Image.open(TARGET).convert("RGB"))
    mask = rgb.mean(axis=2) < 128
    raw = centerline_paths(mask)
    strokes = join_fragments(raw, 42)
    if len(strokes) != 42:
        raise RuntimeError(f"expected 42 paths, extracted {len(strokes)}")
    dist = ndi.distance_transform_edt(mask)
    return strokes, dist


def sampled_waypoints(path, dist):
    p = np.asarray(path, dtype=np.float64)
    if len(p) > 4:
        p = np.column_stack((ndi.gaussian_filter1d(p[:, 0], 1.0, mode="nearest"),
                             ndi.gaussian_filter1d(p[:, 1], 1.0, mode="nearest")))
    delta = np.diff(p, axis=0)
    arc = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(delta, axis=1))]
    keep = np.r_[True, np.diff(arc) > 1e-5]
    p, arc = p[keep], arc[keep]
    if len(p) < 2:
        return p, np.array([2.0])
    ss = np.arange(0.0, arc[-1], 3.0)
    if len(ss) == 0 or arc[-1] - ss[-1] > 0.6:
        ss = np.r_[ss, arc[-1]]
    else:
        ss[-1] = arc[-1]
    rr = np.interp(ss, arc, p[:, 0])
    cc = np.interp(ss, arc, p[:, 1])
    radii = ndi.map_coordinates(dist, [rr, cc], order=1, mode="nearest")
    widths_mm = 2.0 * radii * MM_PER_PX
    widths_mm = ndi.gaussian_filter1d(widths_mm, 1.0, mode="nearest")
    # Local target width translated to brush penetration; cap junctions.
    pressure_mm = np.clip(widths_mm, 0.8, 6.5)
    return np.column_stack((rr, cc)), pressure_mm


def paper_xyz(row, col):
    x = PAPER_FAR_X - (float(row) + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX / 1000.0
    y = PAPER_LEFT_Y - (float(col) + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX / 1000.0
    return x, y


def load_state():
    if STATE.exists():
        return json.loads(STATE.read_text())
    return {"completed": [], "stroke_count": 0, "actions": []}


def save_state(state):
    ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    STATE.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2))


def do_stroke(robot, idx, path, dist, state):
    px, press = sampled_waypoints(path, dist)
    xyz = [paper_xyz(rc[0], rc[1]) for rc in px]
    poses = [[xyz[0][0], xyz[0][1], HOVER_Z, *DOWN],
             [xyz[0][0], xyz[0][1], PAPER_Z - press[0] / 1000.0, *DOWN]]
    for (x, y), d in zip(xyz[1:], press[1:]):
        poses.append([x, y, PAPER_Z - d / 1000.0, *DOWN])
    poses.append([xyz[-1][0], xyz[-1][1], HOVER_Z, *DOWN])
    res = robot.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(poses, dtype=np.float32), dt=0.05,
                       cameras=["canvas_cam", "side_cam"], video="none",
                       note=f"target stroke {idx:02d}/42")
    failures = sum(int(p.get("ik_failures", 0)) for p in res.meta.get("plan", []))
    if failures:
        raise RuntimeError(f"stroke {idx}: {failures} IK failures; stopped before marking it complete")
    if res.meta.get("rejected"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"stroke {idx} rejected: {res.meta['rejected']}")
    state["completed"].append(idx)
    state["stroke_count"] = len(state["completed"])
    state["actions"].append({"stroke": idx, "rows": len(poses), "sim_time_s": res.meta.get("sim_time_s"),
                             "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"), "plan": res.meta.get("plan")})
    save_state(state)
    print(f"stroke {idx:02d}: rows={len(poses)} steps={res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk')} "
          f"IK_failures={failures} left={res.meta.get('time_left_s')}s", flush=True)
    return res


def park_and_capture(robot, label):
    pose = np.array([*PARK, *DOWN], dtype=np.float32)
    r = robot.submit("ee_pose", pose, dt=0.5, cameras=["canvas_cam", "practice_cam"],
                     video="none", note=f"park for {label}")
    r = robot.submit("ee_pose", pose, dt=0.25, cameras=["canvas_cam", "practice_cam"],
                     video="none", note=f"settle for {label}")
    if "canvas_cam" in r.last:
        Image.fromarray(r.last["canvas_cam"]).save(ROOT / f"{label}_canvas.png")
    if "practice_cam" in r.last:
        Image.fromarray(r.last["practice_cam"]).save(ROOT / f"{label}_practice.png")
    return r


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--pilot", type=int, help="execute only this zero-based stroke path, then park")
    ap.add_argument("--plan-only", action="store_true", help="derive the plan without connecting or moving")
    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, help="maximum number of unrecorded strokes to execute")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    strokes, dist = make_plan()
    if args.plan_only:
        print(f"planned {len(strokes)} strokes")
        for i, p in enumerate(strokes):
            print(i, len(p), tuple(p[0].astype(int)), tuple(p[-1].astype(int)))
        return
    robot = Robot(timeout=120)
    state = load_state()
    if args.pilot is not None:
        if not 0 <= args.pilot < len(strokes):
            raise ValueError("pilot index out of range")
        selected = [args.pilot]
    else:
        selected = [i for i in range(len(strokes)) if i not in state["completed"]]
        if args.limit is not None:
            selected = selected[:max(0, args.limit)]
    if not selected:
        print("all target strokes are already recorded")
        return
    print(f"executing {len(selected)} strokes: {selected}", flush=True)
    for n, i in enumerate(selected, 1):
        do_stroke(robot, i, strokes[i], dist, state)
        # Periodic parking keeps the overhead view clear and provides an audit frame.
        if n % 6 == 0 and n < len(selected):
            park_and_capture(robot, f"checkpoint_{n:02d}")
    park_and_capture(robot, "pilot" if args.pilot is not None else "final")
    print("done", json.dumps(robot.status(), indent=2)[:2500], flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
